description: Initial prototype model: 12 concepts, no domain release, department/domain split unresolved
Replace department with domain. Eliminates contradiction (no in-app domain mgmt). Vocabulary aligned.
Collapse 3 collection flavors into 1 concept. Fold cut into asset. 12->9 concepts.
Integrate domain release into share dialog. Domains as recipients alongside people/groups. +10% coverage.
Demote group, review link, inbox, role group to features. 9->5 core concepts. Hit target.
Add collection versioning. Re-turnovers = re-share creating version. Covers F8/F13.
Add sensitive media as CAM capability flag. Orthogonal to permissions. Covers Q7.
Define cross-app: domain shares travel (CAM-backed), person shares are app-specific. Push to CR = release to CR domain.
Resolve F3 (different results) via transparency: show filter + personalized counts. 100% coverage.
Auto-release as shared filtered collection. Elegant but degradation risk: fragile if tagging inconsistent.
Auto-release as project-level admin setting. Matches existing Content Hub feature. No tagging dependency.
